3 dIpakaH 4 SrIrAgaH 5 meGaH 6 । hanUmadBaratayormmate pratyekamezAM paYca rAgiRyaH । someSvarakallinATayormmate pratyekametezAM zaw rAgiRyaH । etezAM pratyekamazwO puttrAH ekEkaputtraBAryyA ca । kallinATasomeSvaramate zaqrAgA yaTA । SrIrAgaH 1 vasantaH 2 paYcamaH 3 BEravaH 4 meGaH 5 nawanArAyaRaH 6 । iti nAnAsaMgItaSAstram ॥ * ॥ aTa rAgasya vyutpattisaMKyAsTAnAni । “yEstu cetAMsi rajyante jagattritayavarttinAm । te rAgA iti kaTyante muniBirBaratAdiBiH ॥ gopIBirgItamArabDamekEkaM kfzRasanniDO । tena jAtAni rAgARAM sahasrARi tu zoqaSa ॥ rAgezu tezu zawtriMSadrAgA jagati viSrutAH । kAlakrameRa tatrApi hnAsa eva tu dfSyate । kecidvadanti te rAgAH sarvve santIti niScitam ॥ meroruttarataH pUrvve paScime dakziRe taTA । samudrakaRWe ye deSAstatrAmIzAM pracAraRA ॥” taTA ca । aNgavaNgakaliNgatelaNgaBUliNgahAvaNgasuraNgayUpalaNgaKelANgasOvIrakIrakASmIranABIranAhIrasinDujAlanDaramagamagaDanizaDamalayahIhayagajAhvayamAlavajAlavamarumUrucolotkalakuntalasiMhalaharikelakerala- rAgAH pracarantIti । “yasya SravaRamAtreRa raYjante sakalAH prajAH । sarvvAGaraYjanAdDetostena rAga iti smftaH ॥” * ॥ aTa rAgAH । “AdO mAlavarAgendrastato mallArasaMjYitaH । SrIrAgaSca tataH paScAdvasantastadanantaram ॥ hindolaScATa karRAwa ete rAgAH zaqeva tu । 6 । zawtriMSadrAgiRI tatra kramaSaH kaTitA mayA ॥ DAnasI mAlasI cEva rAmakirI ca sinDuqA । ASAvarI BEravI ca mAlavasya priyA imAH ॥ 6 velAvalI ca puravI kAnaqA mADavI taTA । koqA kedArikA cApi mallAradayitA imAH ॥ 6 gAnDArI SuBagA cEva gOrI kOmArikA taTA । veloyArI ca vErAgI SrIrAgasya priyA imAH ॥ 6 tuqI ca paYcamI cEva lalitA paWamaYjarI । gujjarI ca viBAzA ca vasantasya priyA imAH ॥ 6 mAyUrI dIpikA cEva deSakArI ca pAhiqA । varAqI BorahAwI ca hindolasya priyA imAH ॥ 6 ॥ nAwikA cATa BUpAlI rAmakelI gaqA taTA । kAmodA cApi kalyARI karRAwasya priyA imAH ॥ 6 ॥ 36 ॥ * ॥ aTa kAlaniyamaH । “viBAzA lalitA cEva kAmodA paWamaYjarI । rAmakIrI rAmakelI veloyArI ca gujjarI ॥ deSakArI ca SuBagA paYcamI ca gaqA tuqI । BEravI cATa kOmArI rAgiRyo daSa paYca ca । etAH pUrvvAhRakAle tu gIyante gAyanottamEH ॥ varAqI mAyUro koqA vErAgI cATa DAnasI । velAvalI morahAwI saptEtA rAgayozitaH । geyA maDyAhnakAle tu yaTA BArataBAzitam ॥ gAnDArI dIpikA cEva kalyARI puravI taTA । kAnaqA SAravI cEva gOrI kedArapAhiqA ॥ mAyUrI mAlasI nAwI BUpAlI sinDuqA taTA । sAyAhne tASca rAgiRyaH pragAyanti caturddaSa ॥ puruzA vastuBUzAQyA rAgAste mAlavAdayaH । pradoze cAparAhRe ca rajanyAM gAnagocarAH ॥ daSadaRqAt paraM rAtrO sarvvezAM gAnamIritam । meGamallArarAgasya gAnaM varzAsu sarvvadA ॥ SrIpaYcamyAM samAraBya yAvat janmotsavaM hareH । tAvadvasantarAgasya gAnamuktaM manIziBiH ॥ SakrotTAnaM samAraBya yAvaddurgAmahotsavam । gIyate tadbuDErnityaM mAlasI sA manoharA ॥ sarvvezAmiha rAgARAM rAgiRInAYca sarvvaSaH । raNgaBUmO nfpAjYAyAM kAladozo na vidyate ॥ rAgaYcAlApayedAdO tatpatnyastadanantaram । nAnyapatnI pragAtavyA nfpAjYAyAM na dUzaRam ॥ rAgAH zaqaTa rAgiRyaH zawtriMSaccAruvigrahAH । AgatA brahmasadanAt brahmARaM samupAsate ॥” * ॥ aTa DyAnam । “nitambinIcumbitavaktrapadmaH SukadyutiH kuRqalavAn pramattaH । saNgItaSAlAM praviSan pradoze mAlADaro mAlavarAgarAjaH ॥ 1 ॥ nIlotpalaM karRayuge vahantI SyAmA sukeSI ca sumaDyaBAgA । IzatsahAsAmbujaramyavaktrA sA DAnasI padmasucArunetrA ॥ 1 ॥ kare yutA cAmbujayugmaramyA itastataScAru vilokayantI । kaRWasParanmOktikaratnahArA sA mAlasI saMkaTitA vicitrA ॥ 2 ॥ prataptacAmIkaracAruvaktrA karRAvataMsaM kamalaM vahantI । puzpaM DanuH puzpaSarErdaDAnA candrAnanA rAmakirI pradizwA ॥ 3 ॥ mahendranIladyutirambujAkzI pravAdayantI kapilASayantram । vicitraratnABaraRA sukeSI sA sinDuqA kAntasamIpasaMsTA ॥ 4 ॥ javAprasUnadyutivimbavaktrA sakaYcupadmaM karayordaDAnA । kzOmAMSukAcCAditagAtrayazwirASAvarI raNgakilA vidagDA ॥ 5 ॥ sarovarasTA sPawikasya mandire saroruhEH SaNkaramarccayantI । tAlaprayogapratiraNgagItErgOrItanurBEravikA satIyam ॥” 6 ॥ * ॥ aTa mallAraH । “vihAraSIlo'tisukAntadehaH kAntApriyo DArmmikaSIlayuktaH । kAmAturaH piNgalanetrayugmo mallArarAgaH priyakft suveSaH ॥ 1 ॥ saNketitotPullalatAnikuYje kftasTitiH kAntasamAgamAya । velAvalI campakamOlinI sA bAlA vicitrABaraRA niruktA ॥ 1 ॥ rahaHsu kAntapriyamARapatraM ramyaM vahantI kucakumBayugme । dUrvvAdalaSyAmatanuH sakAmA purAtanEH sA puravI niruktA ॥ 2 ॥ aSokavfkzasya tale nizaRRA viyoginI vAspakaRAYcitANgI । viBUzitANgI jawileva bAlA sA kAnaqA hemalateva tanvI ॥ 3 ॥ saMgfTya saMgfTya gale daDAnA prasUnamAlA dayitena bAlA । gOrI svakAntAnanacumbitAsyA sA sundarI mADavikA nikuYje ॥ 4 ॥ sukacCapIM vAdayati svaBartturgAnArTamaByasyati sammuKena । sadEva tAlA vihitA ca mAlA koqA kalA tAnavatI matA sA ॥ 5 ॥ snAtvA samuttIrRavatI sudehA keSapraRizyanditavAribinduH । nizpIqayantI timirAMSukAntaM kedArikA raktaparoDaraSrIH ॥” 6 ॥ * ॥ aTa SrIrAgaH । “lIlAvatAreRa vanAntarARi cinvan prasUnAni baDUsahAyaH । vilAsaveSo hyatidivyamUrttiH SrIrAga eza praTitaH pfTivyAm ॥ 1 ॥ sanDyAsukAle gfhamaDyadeSe pravAdayantI ha pinAkayantram । DArADarADAtuvicitritANgI gAnDArikA ganDasrajaM niDatte ॥ 1 ॥ rasanayA suvicArakOtukaM vidaDatI kavikovidakOtukam । sukavitAmftaBAvanatatparA BagavatI suBagA samudAhftA ॥ 2 ॥ puzpodyAne sArdDamAlIkalApEH krIqantyevaM kokilAkAkalIzu । rAmA SyAmA sadguRAnAYca sImA gOrI gOrI gOravAlokadizwA ॥ 3 ॥ awwAlikAyAM sPuwakOmudIBiH prakASitAyAM rajanIvihAram । ahnAya kAntena samaM vasantI kOmArikA kAmakalA vahantI ॥ 4 ॥ gOrIpAdAmBojamaByarccayantI ganDodDUtaM ganDamAlyaM daDAnA । nAnAratnopAyanErBaktiBAvErveloyArI kaTyate bAlikeyam ॥ 5 ॥ ullAsayantI Dammille rahaHsTAn prARabanDunA । mAlatIkusumasragBirvvErAgI rAginI smftA ॥” 6 aTa vasantaH । “cUtANkureREva kftAvataMso viGUrRamAnAruRanetrapadmaH । pItAmbaraH kAYcanacArudeho vasantarAgo yuvatipriyaSca ॥ 1 ॥ sunftyamAnAtisuSIlayuktA muktAlatAkalpitahArayazwiH । cUtANkuraM pARiyuge vahantI javAruRANgI tuqikeriteyam ॥ 1 ॥ saMgItagozWIzu garizWaBAvaM samASritA gAyanasampradAyEH । KarvvANginI nUpurapAdapadmA sA paYcamI paYcamavedavettrI ॥ 2 ॥ urasi keSacayasya suBAraM vidaDatI SayanotTitacAruveSam । vilulitAlakavallikfSANgI BAsurA lalitA kaTitA buDEH ॥ 3 ॥ saKIkalApEH parihAsyamAnA viyoginI kAntaviyogadehA । pInastanI cEva DarAprasuptA SyAmA sukeSI paWamaYjarIyam ॥ 4 ॥ karRotpalAlambimaDuvratAlI SfRoti sA maYjulakUjitAni । kAntAntikaM gantumanAH pradoze sA gujjarI veSakalocitANgI ॥ 5 ॥ aDyApayantI nijaSizyavfndaM saNgItaSAstrARi vivecanABiH । manoharA hAralatABirAmA samastaBAzAkuSalA viSezA ॥” 6 ॥ * ॥ aTa hindolaH । “hAsABilAsena patan pfTivyAM utTApitastatkzaRamAlivfndEH । ullolasaNgItarasErvidagDo hindolarAgaH kaTito rasajYEH ॥ 1 ॥ mayUrakekASravaRollasantI mayUrikAnftyatataM kirantI । mayUrakAntIva sitiM daDAnA mAyUrikA saMkaTitA guRajYEH ॥ 1 ॥ pradozakAle gfhasaMpravizwA pradIpahastAruRagAtravastrA । sImantasindUravirAjamAnA suraktamAlyA kila dIpikeyam ॥ 2 ॥ sArdDaM saKIBirvijane vasantI vicitravakzojanitambasaNgA । nirIkzyamARAnanadarpaRA yA sA deSakArI kaTitA guRajYEH ॥ 3 ॥ BartturdaDAnA caraRAravindaM nizeDayantI paradeSayAnam । prakAmadAmpatyasuKe nimagnA sA pAhiqA saMkaTitA kavIndrEH ॥ 4 ॥ karRe daDAnA surapuzpayugmaM sPuratsuvakzojamanoharANgI । smerAnanA cAruvilolanetrA varANganeyaM kaTitA vaqArI ॥ 5 ॥ utpannamAtre praTamAparADe mAnaM punaH karttamanAScIreRa । fjusvaBAvAnniyataM rudantI sA morahAwI haWakeliruzwA ॥” 6 ॥ * ॥ aTa karRAwaH । “kfpARapARisturagADirUQo mayUrakaRWAtisukaRWakAntiH । sPuratsitasnigDarasaH praSAntaH karRAwarAgo haritAlavarRaH ॥ 1 ॥ ciraM nawantI SuBaraNgamaDye saMprArTayantI nawinaM vasantam । sugItatAlezu kftAvaDAnA nawI suSAwIpariDAnadehA ॥ 1 ॥ svanAyakaM puzpalatADirUQA hasanmuKI sarvvamudaM vahantI । svanAni SaSvadvitanoti mugDA BUpAlikA sA sKaladuttarIyA ॥ 2 ॥ aDyApayantI SukasArasAroH SrIrAma rAmeti suveSalakzmIH । vAmastanArdDasKalitAMSukaSrIH SrIrAmakelI kaTitA kavIndrEH ॥ 3 ॥ viSezavEdagDyavatI samastAn kalAvilAsena vimohayantI । bfhannitambA paripuzwadehA vaqA pralambastanaBAraBavyA ॥ 4 ॥ BarttuH samaM pATasi santarantI payovihAreRa saroruhARi । vicinvatI sOraBamodamAnA kAmodarAgiRyuditA guRajYEH ॥ 5 ॥ vyADUtA nawanftyapariSrameRa bAlA lIlABiH sudatI kftAdarA । nawInAM kalyARI kalayati mattahastI eRaprasTAnaM muKaritA kiNkiRIkalApam ॥” 6 ॥ aTa rAgarAgiRInAM BAvanirUpaRam । “mAlavaH SrISca hindolo mallArastadanantaram । gAyanti gAyakA DIra sAnandena catuzwayam ॥ vasanto rAgaH karRAwo dvO vIrO BavataH kramAt ॥ DAnasI mAlasI cEva BEravI mADavI taTA । suBagA paYcamI nAwI veloyArI ca gujjarI ॥ kAmodA cApi kalyARI koqA kedArikA tuqI । kOmArI mAyUrI cEva deSakArI ca sinDuqA ॥ rAmakelI ca BUpAlI rAgiRyaSceti viMSatiH । AnandAMSA iti proktA gIyante gAnakovidEH ॥ puravI kAnaqA gOrI rAmakirI ca dIpikA । ASAvarI viBAzA ca vaqArI ca gaqA taTA । etASca nava rAgiRyo vIrAMSe gAnamuttamam ॥ velAvalI ca gAnDArI lalitA paWamaYjarI । vErAgI rAgiRI cApi morahAwI ca pAhiqA । karuRAMSA vijAnIyAt saptEtA rAgayozitaH ॥ rAgeRa rasaBAgena zawtriMSadrAgiRIzu ca । karuRAnandavIrezu jYApanArTaM matatrayam ॥” iti saMgItadAmodare SivanAradasaMvAde 1 । 3 aDyAyO ॥ (taTA ca saMgItadarpaRe । aTa rAgARAmudBavaM darSayati । “SivaSaktisamAyogAdrAgARAM samBavo Bavet । paYcAsyAt paYca rAgAH syuH zazWastu girijAmuKAt ॥ sadyovaktrAttu SrIrAgo vAmadevAd vasantakaH । aGorAd BEravo'BUt tatpuruzAt paYcamo'Bavat ॥ ISAnAKyAnmeGarAgo nAwyAramBe SivAdaBUt । girijAyA muKAllAsye nawwanArAyaRo'Bavat ॥” aTa rAgavelA । “maDumADavI ca deSAKyA BUpAlI BEravI taTA । velAvalI ca mallArI vallArI somagurjjarI ॥ DanASrIrmAlavaSrISca meGarAgaSca paYcamaH । deSakArI BEravaSca lalitA ca vasantakaH ॥ ete rAgAH pragIyante prAtarAraBya nityaSaH । gurjjarI kOSikaScEva sAverI paWamaYjarI ॥ revA guRakirI cEva BEravI rAmakiryyapi । sOrAwI ca taTA geyA praTamapraharottaram ॥ vErAwI toqikA cEva kAmodI ca kuqAyikA । gAnDArI nAgaSabdI ca taTA deSI viSezataH । SaNkarABaraRo geyo dbitIyapraharAt param ॥ SrIrAgo mAlavAKyaSca gOrI trivaRasaMjYikA । nawwakalyARasaMjYaSca sAraNganawwakO taTA ॥ sarvve nAwASca kedArI karRAwyABIrikA taTA । vaqahaMsI pahAQI ca tftIyapraharAt param । ardDarAtrAvaDi jYeyA ete rAgAH suKapradAH ॥ yaToktakAla evEte geyAH pUrvvaviDAnataH । rAjAjYayA sadA geyA na tu kAlaM vicArayet ॥” iti rAgavelA । aTa ftavaH । “SrIrAgo rAgiRIyuktaH SiSire gIyate buDEH । vasantaH sasahAyastu vasantarttO pragIyate ॥ BEravaH sasahAyastu ftO grIzme pragIyate । paYcamastu taTA geyo rAgiRyA saha SArade ॥ meGarAgo rAgiRIBiryukto varzAsu gIyate । nawwanArAyaRo rAgo rAgiRyA saha hemake ॥ yaTecCayA vA gAtavyAH sarvvarttuzu suKapradAH ॥” iti rAyARAM ftunirRayaH । iti someSvaramatam ॥ * ॥)

a musical note, harmony, melody (in the later system a partic. musical mode or order of sound or formula; Bharata enumerates 6, viz. भैरव, कौशिक, हिन्दोल, दीपक, श्री-राग, and मेघ, each mode exciting some affection; other writers give other names; sometimes 7 or 26 Rāgas are mentioned; they are personified, and each of the 6 chief Rāgas is wedded to 5 or 6 consorts called Rāgiṇīs; their union gives rise to many other musical modes), Bhar.; Saṃgīt.; Rājat.; Pañcat. &c.
nasalization, RPrāt.
a partic. process in the preparation of quicksilver, Sarvad.
seasoning, condiment, Car.
a prince, king, L.

the moon, L.
a: रागः — [रंज्-भावे घञ् नि˚ नलोपकुत्वे] 1 (a) Colouring, dyeing, tinging. (b) Colour, hue, dye; Pt. 1. 33. --2 Red colour, redness; अधरः किसलयरागः Ś. 1. 21. --3 Red dye, red lac; रागेण बालारुणकोमलेन चूतप्रवालोष्ठमलंचकार Ku. 3. 30, 5. 11. --4 Love, passion, affection, amorous or sexual feeling; मलिनेपि रागपूर्णां Bv. 1. 100 (where it means ‘redness’ also); अथ भवंतमंतरेण कीदृशोऽस्या दृष्टिरागः Ś. 2; see चक्षूराग also; चरणयुगलादिव हृदयमविशद्रागः K. 142. --5 Feeling, emotion, sympathy, interest. --6 Joy, pleasure. --7 Anger, wrath. --8 Loveliness, beauty. --9 A musical mode or order of sound; (there are six primary Rāgas; भैरवः कौशिकश्चैव हिंदोलो दीपकस्तथा . श्रीरागो मेघरागश्च रागाः षडिति कीर्तिताः Bharata; other writers give different names. Each rāga has six rāginīs regarded as its consorts, and their union gives rise to several musical modes). --10 Musical harmony, melody; तवास्मि गीतरागेण हारिणा प्रसभं हृतः Ś. 1. 5; अहो रागपरिवाहिणी गीतिः Ś. 5. --11 Regret, sorrow. --12 Greediness, envy. --13 The quality called Rajas q. v. --14 Nasalization. --15 A process in the preparation of quicksilver. --16 A king, prince. --17 The sun. --18 The moon. --Comp. --अशनिः a Buddha or Jina. --आत्मक a. impassioned. --आयातं, --उद्रेकः excess of passion. --खाडव, खांडव see रागषाडव. --चूर्णः {1} Acasia Catechu or Khadira tree. {2} red lead. {3} lac. {4} red powder thrown by people over one another at the festival called holi. {5} the god of love. --छन्नः the god of love. --द्रव्यं a colouring substance, a paint, dye. --दा crystal. --दालिः a kind of pulse (मसूर). --पट्टः a kind of precious stone. --पुष्पः, --प्रसवः the red globe-amaranth. --बंधः manifestation of feeling, interest created by a proper representation (of various emotions); भावो भावं नुदति विषयाद्रागबंधः स एव M. 2. 9. --युज् m. a ruby. --रज्जुः the god of love. --लता N. of Rati, wife of Cupid. --लेखा a streak or mark of paint. --वृंतः the god of love. --षाडवः a kind of sweetmeat. --सूत्रं {1} any coloured thread. {2} a silk-thread. {3} the string of a balance.

a: रागिन् — a. [राग-इनि] 1 Coloured, dyed. --2 Colouring, painting. --3 Red. --4 Full of passion or feeling, impassioned. --5 Full of love, subject to love. --6 Passionately fond of, devotedly attached to, desirous of, yearning after (at the end of comp.). --7 Delighting, rejoicing. --m. 1 A painter. --2 A lover; एको रागिषु राजते प्रियतमादेहार्धहारी हरः Bh. 3. 121. --3 A libertine, sensualist. --णी 1 A modification of a musical mode (राग), of which 30 or 36 kinds are enumerated. --2 A wanton and intriguing woman, a lustful woman.
